relationships.subject: microglial Gi DREADD
relationships.evidence_quote: Gi DREADD activation downregulated the transcription factor interferon regulatory factor 8 (IRF8) and its downstream target pro-inflammatory cytokine interleukin 1 beta (IL-1β)

relationships.subject: microglial Gi DREADD
relationships.evidence_quote: Consequently, these results further indicate that Gi DREADD inhibits microglial activation in response to SNT-induced pain.

relationships.subject: microglial Gi DREADD
relationships.evidence_quote: Taken together, our results indicate that both pre- and post-SNT activation of Gi DREADD in CX3CR1+ cells can suppress the development and the maintenance of neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: IRF8
relationships.evidence_quote: IRF8 is a critical transcription factor for the regulation of pro-inflammatory interleukin 1 beta (IL-1β), which is important for the pathogenesis of chronic pain

key_findings: Chemogenetic Gi DREADD activation in microglia attenuated SNT-induced microglial reactivity and neuropathic pain in both sexes
It reduced IRF8, IL-1β and C-fiber-evoked synaptic transmission
